From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Subject: POC timeline & next steps - Redwood trial with Acme

Hi Alex / Priya / Tom —

Thanks again for the call earlier — great to hear more about the Acme evaluation priorities. Per our discussion, here’s a concise recap and proposed next steps so we can get the POC kicked off quickly.

High-level success criteria (from your side):
- Integration: Redwood API integrated with Acme test dataset and returning generated responses with expected routing controls.
- Latency/Throughput: 95th percentile latency under 300ms for 1k reqs/min test window.
- Cost baseline: unit cost projection for the trial workload to inform next-stage sizing.
- Quality: automated prompt set passes acceptance thresholds (see eval plan).

Proposed evaluation plan & ownership:
- Week 0 (Prep): Redwood provides POC plan + test prompt set (Marissa). Acme shares anonymized sample data and security checklist answers (Alex / Priya).
- Week 1 (Kickoff & Integration): Kickoff + SE-led integration session; Marcus as SE lead.
- Weeks 2-3 (Testing & Tuning): Run load tests, iterate on batching and quantization suggestions; weekly check-ins with both teams.
- Week 4 (Readout): Final metrics, cost projection, and recommended next steps.

Timeline suggestion:
- Kickoff: Mon Aug 24 — 1 hour (integration + success criteria alignment)
- Weekly check-ins: Tuesdays 30 min (Aug 31, Sep 7)
- Final readout: Fri Sep 11

Attachments: acme_poc_plan_v1.pdf (POC plan & milestones), redwood_trial_checklist.xlsx (security & data checklist).

Immediate ask: can you confirm (a) the success criteria above match what you expect, and (b) that Aug 24 works for a kickoff session? Once you confirm, I’ll send a calendar invite and Marcus will prep the integration runbook.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198
